duplicateTitle: Duplicate the selected focus (Ctrl+D). The copy gets its own focus_id.
legendOr: OR badge — any one focus in the block satisfies it
legendAndBlocks: Select a focus and its prerequisite blocks light up in different colors (blocks are AND)
toolbarAutoLayout: Tidy layout — fix levels & mutex, split independent storylines, compact
compactConfirm: Compacting pulls nodes toward their prerequisites. This tree has {total} nodes; {count} of them ({percent}%) will move. One Ctrl+Z undoes it. Continue?
layoutMutexConflict: {count} focus(es) can't share a row with their mutual-exclusion peers — they require each other as prerequisites
